steps.last: Yeah, I’m sure. We have a red mailbox, remember?
I’m right in front of it.
someone just knocked on my door. twice.
Lil, I'm at home. I'm in bed.
I know. I can see you typing.
but he's out there saying he's you. says he lost his phone.
Sam, it's your voice. exactly your voice.
the flat next door's empty. Mrs Hale moved out in June
nobody saw her move out. her things are still in there
and for weeks I've heard someone in there at night. repeating my phone calls through the wall. word for word.
0:10Sam… Sam, listen… listen… he won't stop… it sounds like you… (behind the door: Lil, it's me, it's Sam… just open the door)
drafts: Open it. Let's see who it is. I'm right here with you.
Don't open. Whatever it is, it isn't me.

steps.last: Mrs Hale's door is open. smells like wet soil
sorry. dropped my phone. all fine, it was just the pipes :)
knock twice so I know it's you
steps.end: Two Knocks | Ending 1 of 3 · Invited In

it's trying voices. like keys on a ring

they put that wall up in June. it's just plasterboard

steps.last: called 999. a woman answered. she's so calm
she says officers are on their way up. they'll knock twice so I know it's them
twice? did you tell her about our knock?
her voice. Sam, I know her voice
